candidate.answerReason: Five divisions reach 50 mm, while six reach 60 mm and accommodate 55 mm.

methods.label: Calculate the required divisions
methods.explanation: \(55\div10=5.5\). Even a partial division requires an additional division, so at least 6 divisions are needed.
methods.levelReason: Elementary division and choosing enough whole axis divisions are within Grade 7 chart construction.

review.mathematicalCheck: Five divisions reach only 50 mm, while six reach 60 mm. Therefore six is both sufficient and the minimum whole number of divisions accommodating 55 mm.
review.levelCheck: Elementary division and rounding upward for capacity are appropriate for Grade 7; no formal ceiling notation is needed.
